cue: When adopting reusable workflow guidance for evidence-heavy document-review tasks
lesson: Prioritize capturing concrete independent-verification procedures (recompute math, verify every record cite, flag cited-but-missing evidence) over generic tool guidance
evidence: DOM's memory.md encoding the independent-verification workflow produced strictly more findings than the reference, while INV's tool_guidance was neutral (no measurable benefit)

cue: When a task requires chaining file-extraction tool calls and prior runs show tracebacks, guessed flags, /tmp write blocks, or truncated dumps
lesson: Adopt workflow discipline in tool guidance — read-first parsing, reading full errors before retrying, persisting extractions under the workspace scratch folder, and verifying dump tails — instead of storing the fix as episodic memory
evidence: Probe contrast: the reference run hit sandbox tracebacks and wrong-flag retries and dumped to /tmp where later calls were blocked; mandating read-first parsing, error-before-retry, and workspace-persisted extractions removed those frictions, while the memory-based variant showed no additional benefit

cue: Deciding whether to adopt harness edits after A/B probe runs when output quality is unchanged
lesson: Adopt changes that fix demonstrated execution friction (wasted turns, failed tool calls) but skip neutral changes when both runs already produce complete, equivalent deliverables — keep beats adopt when the edit buys nothing observable.
evidence: Contrast showed both runs produced complete memos with the same core findings; the adopted tool_guidance.md addressed repeated read_doc.py tracebacks and truncated reads, while the rejected DOM memory edit showed no output difference.

cue: When analyzing long documents with tables (cap tables, ledgers) pulled from large dumps
lesson: Persist full extractions to files, verify the tail, and recompute all totals yourself instead of trusting stated subtotals or truncated console output
evidence: Blind retries of the extraction script produced traceback churn and silently truncated stdout ('output truncated ... N chars'), hiding table tails; persisted scratch dumps plus recomputation surfaced errors in stated ownership-column subtotals that transcription alone would have propagated

cue: Any task requiring extraction of input documents where console output or parser scripts may fail or truncate
lesson: Use the harness read tool first, persist parsed dumps to disk, and validate dump completeness (tail/line count) before relying on extracted text for deliverables
evidence: The reference run suffered repeated read_doc.py sandbox failures and truncated console dumps, while the INV candidate's harness-read-first, dump-persistence, and tail-validation discipline mitigated these; the DOM memory candidate showed no comparable contrast and was judged neutral
